lead.question: 天天惦记着写明信片的人，为什么假期结束时连一张也没寄出去？
lead.warmup: 度假时写明信片寄给亲友，曾是再普通不过的问候方式，可“惦记着要写”和真的动笔之间，往往隔着一场拖延。本课作者去年夏天去了意大利，玩得十分尽兴，却偏偏被明信片搅得心神不宁。听读时请留意两点：一是全文几乎全用一般过去时串起去年夏天那段已经结束的经历；二是留意 send、lend、teach、buy 这类动词后面常常跟着两个宾语。
goals: 能用一般过去时连贯复述一次发生并结束于过去的旅行经历，正确搭配 last summer、on the last day 等过去时间状语
理解 send、lend、teach、buy 等动词带双宾语的语序，能在 send sb. sth. 与 send sth. to sb. 之间转换
理解 not a word、not a single card 的强调否定，以及 spoil、whole、a few 的确切含义
会写 make a big decision、spend the whole day、think about 等本课搭配，转述自己的度假计划
lead.summary: 去年夏天作者去意大利度假，逛博物馆、在公园里坐坐，一位友好的服务员教他几句意大利语还借给他一本书，他却一行也没读懂。整个假期他天天惦记着明信片，最后一天痛下决心买回三十七张，关在房间里待了一整天，结果竟连一张也没写成。全文以一般过去时记述这段往事，并集中操练 send、lend 一类的双宾语动词。
lead.tips: friendly 虽以 -ly 结尾却是形容词（He is friendly），不能写成 He taught me Italian friendly，要说 in a friendly way；顺带记牢 lend 借出（lend sb. sth.），borrow 借入（borrow sth. from sb.）。

questions.q: How many cards did the writer send?
questions.zh: 作者寄了多少张明信片？
questions.a: He did not send any cards. He bought thirty-seven cards and spent the whole day in his room, but he did not write a single card.
questions.aZh: 一张也没寄出去。他买了三十七张明信片，在房间里待了整整一天，却连一张也没有写成。
questions.hint: 答案在课文最后三句：On the last day I made a big decision. / I got up early and bought thirty-seven cards. / I spent the whole day in my room, but I did not write a single card!

questions.q: What did the writer do in Italy last summer?
questions.zh: 去年夏天作者在意大利做了些什么？
questions.a: He visited museums and sat in public gardens. A friendly waiter taught him a few words of Italian and lent him a book.
questions.aZh: 他参观了博物馆，还到公园里坐坐；一位友好的服务员教了他几句意大利语，并借给他一本书。
questions.hint: 见课文第 3、4 句：I visited museums and sat in public gardens. 与 A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian. Then he lent me a book.

questions.q: In the sentence Then he lent me a book, which is the direct object and which is the indirect object?
questions.zh: Then he lent me a book 一句里，lend 的直接宾语和间接宾语分别是什么？
questions.a: The indirect object is me and the direct object is a book. Lend takes two objects, just like send and buy.
questions.aZh: me 是间接宾语（人），a book 是直接宾语（物）；lend 与 send、buy 一样可带双宾语。
questions.hint: 见课文第 4 句后半部分，讲义语法部分也列举了 give、show、send、lend、teach 等可带双宾语的动词。

questions.q: What does not a single card tell us about that last day?
questions.zh: not a single card 这个说法说明了什么？
questions.a: Not a single card is a much stronger negative than not a card: he bought thirty-seven cards and stayed in his room all day, yet he wrote none of them.
questions.aZh: not a single card 比朴素的 not a card 语气更强：他买了三十七张，整天待在房间里，却一张也没写出来。
questions.hint: 见课文最后一句 I spent the whole day in my room, but I did not write a single card!

questions.q: The writer thought about postcards every day, so why did he write none of them? And what does the first line really mean?
questions.zh: 作者天天惦记着明信片，为什么最后一张也没写成？开篇那句“明信片总搅得我假日不得安宁”究竟是什么意思？
questions.a: The postcards became a worry hanging over the whole holiday: he thought about them every day, then made a big decision, bought thirty-seven cards and shut himself in his room for the whole day, but he had left everything to the last day and managed to write not a single one.
questions.aZh: 明信片成了压在整个假期上的心事：他天天想着，最后还作出决定、一口气买回三十七张并闭门一整天，却因为把事情全拖到最后一天而一张也没写成。所谓 spoil my holidays，正是说写寄明信片这件心事破坏了度假的乐趣。
questions.hint: 把第 1 句的总起与第 6 至 10 句连起来体会：第 6 句 Every day I thought about postcards。

exercises.q: 汉译英：请把一张明信片寄给我。
exercises.note: send sb. sth. = send sth. to sb.

exercises.q: 句型转换：把间接宾语移到句末改写句子。A friendly waiter taught me a few words of Italian.
exercises.a: A friendly waiter taught a few words of Italian to me.
exercises.note: 直宾提前时，人前须加 to。

exercises.q: 汉译英：到了最后一天，我作出了一项重大决定。
exercises.a: On the last day I made a big decision.
exercises.note: make a decision 是固定搭配。

exercises.q: 填空：I ______ a book from the waiter, and he ______ it to me last summer.
exercises.note: borrow from 借入，lend to 借出。

exercises.q: 改错：He taught me a few words of Italian friendly.
exercises.a: He taught me a few words of Italian in a friendly way.
exercises.note: friendly 是形容词，不能作副词。

exercises.q: 填空：Last summer I ______ (go) to Italy and ______ (visit) museums every day.
exercises.note: last summer 明确指过去，只配一般过去时。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我在房间里待了整整一天，可连一张明信片也没写成。
exercises.a: I spent the whole day in my room, but I did not write a single card!
exercises.note: spend 表度过，whole 强调整整。

quiz.q: 课文原句 I visited museums and sat in public gardens 中的 public gardens 指什么？
options: The waiter's private garden
Parks open to everyone
A quiet museum in Italy
The garden behind the hotel
quiz.note: public 意为公共的、公众的，反义词是 private；public gardens 即人人可进的公园。

quiz.q: 下列哪一句正确地表达了“之后他把一本书借给了我”？
options: Then he borrowed me a book.
Then he lent me a book.
Then he borrowed a book to me.
Then he lent a book for me.
quiz.note: lend 表借出，可带双宾语 lend sb. sth.；borrow 表借入，须用 borrow sth. from sb.

quiz.q: 要表达“去年夏天我去了意大利”，下列哪一句时态正确？
options: Last summer I have gone to Italy.
Last summer I went to Italy.
Last summer I go to Italy.
Last summer I am going to Italy.
quiz.note: last summer 是明确指过去的时间状语，只与一般过去时连用。

quiz.q: friendly 是形容词，那么“他亲切地教我意大利语”正确的英文是？
options: He taught me Italian friendly.
He taught me Italian in a friendly way.
He taught me Italian friendlyly.
He taught friendly me Italian.
quiz.note: 以 -ly 结尾的词未必是副词；friendly 只能作形容词，修饰动作要用 in a friendly way。

quiz.q: 课文中用来强调整天关在房间却一张也没写成的句子是？
options: I did not write cards.
I wrote only one card.
I did not write a single card!
I never write cards.
quiz.note: not a single 表示“连一个也不”，比简单的 not a 否定语气更强。

quiz.q: “我在房间里度过了整整一天”最贴切的英文是？
options: I cost the whole day in my room.
I spent the whole day in my room.
I took all the day in my room.
I used the whole day in my room.
quiz.note: spend 与时间段连用时表示度过；whole 表示整整的。
